title: Database calls for 40 orders and 10 customers
method: Synthetic query: 40 orders reference 10 distinct customers. Naive 1 + 40 = 41; cache 1 + 10 = 11; batch 1 + 1 = 2. Assumes one authorization context and compatible batching. Call counts do not imply proportional latency gains.
alt: Database calls for 40 orders and 10 customers. Naive field resolution: 41 database calls; Request cache only: 11 database calls; Compatible batch lookup: 2 database calls. Illustrative inputs.
